claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the nonshared protected identifier, Army name with junior suffix, Alabama birth and residence, 1915 birth year, artist occupation, and mutually compatible institutional art records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The combined records establish a dated prewar artistic identity but do not identify an OSS entry date or immediate predecessor employer.
claims.match_notes: No single public source exposes the protected identifier. The identity is high-confidence rather than confirmed from a digitized OSS personnel file.
